recommendations.rationale: Every route has 0% coverage of this stage. repository_understanding, reasoning, long_context, and instruction_following have no tier A source, so no route can be ranked and the configured chain is unchanged for lack of evidence, not for lack of merit. Do not read this as support for the current chain.

Every route has 0% coverage. reasoning and adversarial_analysis have no tier A source and repository_understanding is unmeasured, so plan review cannot be ranked by published data. Local plan samples remain the only route to evidence for this stage.

openai-codex/gpt-5.6-sol (0.775) and opencode-go/glm-5.3 (0.734) tie for rank 1 within the 0.05 tolerance, and opencode-go/glm-5.3 dominates on both input and output price (1.40/4.40 against 5.00/30.00 USD per million tokens). It is a candidate to add as an implementation secondary. This is additive: the configured rank 1, opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash, is unrankable here because its only software-engineering observation is proxy-family and unscored, so it cannot be compared and must not be replaced on this evidence. The configured ranks 2 and 3 already match the attested rank-2 group.

The configured rank 1, openai-codex/gpt-5.6-sol, has no review observation at all: it covers only 30% of this stage through software_engineering and is evidence-only. Four enabled routes carry review evidence, led by opencode-go/kimi-k2.7-code at 0.885 with a 0.154 gap to the next candidate, well above the separation tolerance. Recommend moving opencode-go/kimi-k2.7-code to rank 1 and keeping openai-codex/gpt-5.6-sol at rank 2, so the stage gains its primary capability without losing the incumbent. Apply only after the validation step in section 9: the evidence is one vendor harness at 50% coverage, judged by one LLM whose rescoring noise is about 2 points, and absence of a published row for the incumbent is missing evidence, not proof of worse review.

mistral/zai-glm-5-2 is the only route that reaches the coverage threshold for this stage (0.407 at 60%), so it is worth adding as a break secondary. Read it narrowly: adversarial_analysis carries 0.4 of the stage and has no tier A source, so 60% of the rank comes from review and software_engineering. The configured rank 1, opencode-go/hy3, has 0% coverage and cannot be assessed either way.

No route has evidence for instruction_following, reasoning, long_context, or multimodal with which this stage is weighted, so the session-start model cannot be ranked. Its 0.20/1.20 price and 272K context are operational facts, not routing-quality results.
